newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong CDU full operation seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Yukong CDU full operation seen delayed.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, sees full production of its new 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) delayed until October 8, company officials said on Monday.
Yukong had expected full production by September 30.
"We are having a little trouble with the new topper," a Yukong official told Reuters. "We've spotted several cracks in the topper's pipeline welding joints and we are now fixing them."

Yukong started feeding crude oil to the unit early this month but hasn't produced any oil products yet because of the cracks, he said. Officials were unable to pinpoint when the first products would materialise.
The new CDU will raise Yukong's total refining capacity to 810,000 bpd.
